name: 20744 · Ft Washington, MD
findings: ZIP 20744 (Ft Washington) has 306 nonprofit organizations. 130 of them (42%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 105 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (40% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 20744 (Ft Washington) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
